verdict.rationale: A built-in AI assistant is a fair question for a SaaS storage product like Google Drive, but nothing in the evidence shows one that users can delegate tasks to. The closest item (docs-4) describes developers building their own AI agent add-on with ADK and Vertex AI, which is third-party extensibility rather than a built-in assistant. The OCR and AI-moderation mentions are not assistants users can delegate to.
